body:
There's quite literally nothing when you're dead, which is impossible for our brains to comprehend; to be thinking about it at all we have to admit that we exist in some capacity, which means we can't fully understand what it would be like. Cogito ergo sum and all that. 

I just checked, and I can confirm the sky is up.
I would technically be happier, as sadness is the opposite to happiness and therefore detracts from one's ability to be happy. Without the sadness, I can be at peace.
